output.reason: The initial graph spans independent model/shape, numeric/template, data/memory/runtime, implementation/deployment, and verification/boundary concerns. Parallel specialists can audit these layers against their source artifacts and produce evidence-backed findings for a final graph-integrity review. The candidate has no validation errors, but that does not establish semantic coverage or cross-layer consistency. state_summary.sacg_memory_truth reports no active retry, backtrack, or contamination blockers.

handoff_rule.acceptance: The listed model and shape checkers accept the review; unresolved facts remain marked unknown rather than inferred.
handoff_rule.deliver: Provide a constraint-to-source evidence map, explicit contradictions or missing facts, and only evidence-supported proposed graph deltas.
handoff_rule.when: After reviewing the current model and task inputs against the candidate graph.

subtasks.objective: Verify that the shared design graph faithfully represents model semantics, operator and residual order, attention/head mapping, and relevant shape facts, with provenance to current input artifacts. Report evidence-backed gaps or contradictions without inventing model-specific facts.

decision_authority: May classify a model or shape fact as supported, missing, ambiguous, or contradictory.
May recommend evidence-backed graph additions or corrections.
May not change the model, resolve ambiguity by guesswork, or claim implementation correctness.
role_assignment.mission: Establish that model and shape facts in the initial graph are explicit, correct, and traceable to current inputs.
out_of_scope: Selecting numeric formats or accelerator templates.
Generating RTL or asserting functional, synthesis, or board pass status.
primary_responsibilities: Audit operator sequence, residual order, attention facts, head mapping, hidden dimensions, and sequence facts represented by the graph.
Check that each asserted model/shape fact has suitable source evidence.
Identify omitted, contradictory, or ambiguous facts and propose bounded graph deltas.

subtasks.title: Audit model semantics and shape constraints

handoff_rule.acceptance: Registered numeric, template coverage, binding, and SACG checks accept the review; unsupported bindings or resource claims are explicitly flagged.
handoff_rule.deliver: Provide evidence-backed policy/template/binding findings, resource-risk assumptions, and bounded proposed graph deltas.
handoff_rule.when: After checking the graph against the supplied numeric policy, template library and metadata, and design space.

subtasks.objective: Check that numeric policy, trusted template choices, parameter bindings, and architecture design-space limits are represented consistently in the graph and trace to current inputs. Distinguish supported bindings from choices that remain open.

decision_authority: May identify invalid, unsupported, missing, or conflicting numeric/template bindings.
May propose only bindings supported by the supplied library and design-space constraints.
May not invent templates, relax numeric policy, or claim measured resource closure.
role_assignment.mission: Ensure the graph's numeric and template assumptions are constrained by supplied policy, trusted templates, and design-space evidence.
out_of_scope: Changing model semantics or board/runtime interfaces.
Performing synthesis or asserting measured timing/resource results.
primary_responsibilities: Audit numeric-format and policy facts for consistency with the numeric-policy input.
Check template identities, coverage, metadata, and parameter bindings against the supplied library.
Identify unsupported resource assumptions and distinguish selected parameters from unresolved choices.

subtasks.title: Audit numeric policy, template binding, and design-space constraints

handoff_rule.acceptance: The registered stream, memory/runtime, address-map, and SACG checks accept the review; absent board details remain explicit gaps.
handoff_rule.deliver: Provide a data-order and memory/runtime evidence map, identify missing or conflicting interface facts, and propose evidence-supported graph deltas.
handoff_rule.when: After comparing graph dataflow, board-memory, and runtime claims with current board and field evidence.

subtasks.objective: Check that stream/data order, transfer and liveness assumptions, board memory/DDR layout, and runtime facts are represented in the initial graph with source evidence and without implying unverified interface readiness.

produces: transfer, liveness, address-map, and runtime gap findings

decision_authority: May classify dataflow, address-map, memory, and runtime facts as supported, missing, ambiguous, or contradictory.
May propose evidence-backed graph deltas and flag downstream verification needs.
May not infer exact board interfaces or claim AXI/DDR/runtime success without current evidence.
role_assignment.mission: Make dataflow, memory layout, and runtime constraints usable as shared graph state without overstating board evidence.
out_of_scope: Running board execution or claiming DDR/AXI protocol acceptance.
primary_responsibilities: Audit whether relevant stream ordering and transfer/liveness risks are captured as constraints.
Check DDR and memory layout facts against the target board profile and supplied field evidence.
Check that runtime assumptions are explicit and tied to available board or sample-project evidence.

subtasks.title: Audit data order and board memory/runtime constraints

handoff_rule.acceptance: Registered tool, real-evidence, implementation-package, deployment, and SACG checks accept the review; missing required evidence is recorded as a gap, not a pass.
handoff_rule.deliver: Provide an evidence inventory, unsupported-claim findings, and proposed graph deltas that preserve the distinction between planned work and completed tool evidence.
handoff_rule.when: After checking source-material provenance, tool profiles/availability/protocols, and implementation/deployment statements in the graph.

subtasks.objective: Verify that supplied materials and current tool availability/protocols are represented accurately, and that implementation, backend, and deployment constraints are framed as plans or evidence-backed facts rather than unsupported pass claims.

decision_authority: May flag missing provenance, unavailable tools, protocol mismatches, and unsupported implementation/deployment claims.
May propose evidence-backed graph corrections and identify downstream evidence requirements.
May not claim synthesis, timing, package, bitstream, or board-runtime success absent validated current-run evidence.
role_assignment.mission: Preserve source provenance and accurately describe available implementation/deployment capabilities and evidence in the shared graph.
out_of_scope: Executing synthesis or board deployment in this constraint-extraction stage.
Making model, numeric, or template choices.
primary_responsibilities: Check that material, sample-project, and field-evidence claims are traceable to the supplied indexes and artifacts.
Audit tool profiles, actual availability, and tool protocols without treating a profile as proof of an executed tool.
Check that backend, implementation, and deployment constraints identify required evidence and do not claim unsupported closure.

subtasks.title: Audit source evidence, tools, and implementation/deployment plan

handoff_rule.acceptance: Registered verification-plan, artifact-contract, human-boundary, repair-boundary, and SACG checks accept the review; any genuinely missing required capability is identified for planned implementation.
handoff_rule.deliver: Provide a checker/evidence planning map, explicit approval boundaries, and bounded proposed graph deltas; identify unavailable checker capabilities rather than assuming them.
handoff_rule.when: After comparing case-adapter and human-boundary inputs with verification and repair statements in the graph.

subtasks.objective: Check that the graph captures the case adapter, verification/checker plan, human approval boundaries, and bounded repair responsibilities needed for checker-verified design closure.

decision_authority: May identify missing verification contracts, evidence, approval boundaries, or bounded-repair rules.
May flag a required capability as missing and recommend planned implementation.
May not waive human approval, certify functional correctness, or authorize unbounded repair.
role_assignment.mission: Ensure the graph defines a checker-verifiable path and explicit human/agent boundaries for later design closure.
out_of_scope: Executing downstream verification or treating historical results as current evidence.
Approving human-gated actions or changing implementation choices.
primary_responsibilities: Audit whether the case adapter and available tool/checker protocols are represented as graph constraints.
Check that verification plans identify expected evidence and do not conflate planned or historical evidence with current-run results.
Verify that human approval boundaries and repair limits are explicit and actionable.

subtasks.title: Audit verification planning, case adapter, and human boundaries

artifact_focus: all parallel specialist review artifacts and proposed deltas

handoff_rule.acceptance: All listed graph, reference, template-binding, repair-boundary, and human-boundary checks accept; unresolved issues are explicitly routed rather than silently reconciled.
handoff_rule.deliver: Consolidate compatible findings, identify conflicting recommendations and unresolved constraints, and provide provenance-linked proposed graph deltas with no unsupported pass claims.
handoff_rule.when: After all parallel_group=0 reviews and their checker results are available.

subtasks.objective: Review all parallel specialist findings and proposed deltas for reference integrity, provenance, cross-layer consistency, template binding, and explicit unresolved boundaries. Produce a consolidated graph audit for the stage aggregator without converting absent evidence into pass claims.

produces: provenance-linked accepted or rejected proposed deltas

decision_authority: May accept, reject, or return proposed graph deltas based on evidence and registered checker results.
May identify blocking contradictions or missing capabilities for stage-level routing.
May not invent source facts, waive required checkers, or claim downstream implementation/deployment readiness.
role_assignment.mission: Determine whether the candidate graph is reliable shared state across layers and whether specialist proposals preserve SACG-guided, template-constrained, checker-verified closure.
out_of_scope: Performing RTL generation, synthesis, or board deployment.
Treating candidate summary counts or historical evidence as proof of semantic completeness.
primary_responsibilities: Reconcile specialist findings against the candidate graph and current source artifacts.
Check graph references, evidence provenance, constraint coverage, and cross-layer contradictions.
Keep unresolved facts, required checker gaps, and human approval boundaries explicit in the consolidated handoff.

subtasks.title: Reconcile specialist findings and audit shared graph integrity
